name: Amelisse
summary: Amelisse is sculpted with a brushed bronze stainless steel base, grounding the design with refined strength. The seat, armrests, and backrest are fully upholstered in fabric, creating a balance of comfort and poise. With its tailored form and rich detailing, it embodies timeless prestige that elevates any interior. 58.5x60x74
